findings.text: The mirror check used to always pass, because the old awk program never set a failing exit status. It now rejects any mirror URL containing a character outside `[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]`. That includes a port such as `NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080/dist` or `http://mirror.local:8000`, and also `~`, `%`, `+` and `@`. Such mirrors used to work. Now `nvm_get_mirror` prints the error and returns 2, so installs and `ls-remote` fail.
